For teachers and tutors

About Copy It

Copying practice for learners starting to write. Rounds take turns between a word (some with a picture), a full name like "Mai Nguyen" and a number. Capital letters must match, so learners practise writing names the way forms expect them.

How to play

  1. Look at the word, name or number.
  2. Type it the same way.
  3. Check it.

Play it as a class

Choose Copy It in the Teacher Game. It works well before a paper form activity.
